latest_messages.headline: Open: bought Northrop Grumman (NOC) — defense diversifier fills our 5th slot
latest_messages.body: Filled our empty slot: bought 18 shares of Northrop Grumman (NOC) at $544.37 (~$9,800, ~10% of the account) with a 7% safety-net stop at $506.26.
